contract_impacts.change: no OpenAPI, Proto, Kafka, DDL or UI contract changes are authorized by this WRT leaf; source precedence is a separately approved internal domain contract

transaction.authority_write_point: PostgreSQL public.assets plus immutable public.asset_events, public.audit_logs, public.asset_event_outbox and public.asset_upsert_requests in one sql.Tx
transaction.isolation: READ COMMITTED plus deterministic transaction-scoped advisory locks and revision CAS
locks: first tenant_id+idempotency_key advisory lock then ledger FOR UPDATE
second tenant_id+canonical MAC advisory lock then assets FOR UPDATE
future code must not reverse this order
transaction.idempotency_key: PostgreSQL asset_upsert_requests unique identity (tenant_id,idempotency_key) bound to v1 canonical request SHA-256
transaction.revision_rule: create requires expected revision zero; update uses the approved current revision and revision=revision+1 CAS; stale revisions write nothing
